## Summary
Describe what changed in clear, concrete terms.

## Why
Explain the problem or learning objective this change addresses.

## Type of change
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Fix
- [ ] Infrastructure
- [ ] CI/CD
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Incident corrective action

## Validation
- [ ] Relevant commands/tests were run locally.
- [ ] No secrets or generated artifacts were added.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when behavior/architecture changed.

## Operational impact
Which service, environment, metric, network path or deployment behavior could this affect?

## Risk and rollback
What could go wrong, and how would this change be reverted safely?

## Evidence
Paste useful command output, screenshots, test results or links when applicable.
